# On and off by default — the `css-modules` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#css-modules).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** a `*.module.css` or `*.module.scss` file.
- **Rules:** 5 — 0 on, 3 on with `preview = true`, 2 off in an opt-in preset, 0 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `css-modules/recommended` | yes, once the pack is installed | 3 | 2 error, 1 warn | CSS Modules correctness: a class read by JavaScript exists, a class defined is read, composes resolves |
| `css-modules/strict` | no — opt in | 5 | 4 error, 1 warn | css-modules/recommended plus names JavaScript reads without brackets and no :global |

## Rules

`on` runs in a fresh install; a `preview` rule runs only with `preview = true` ([SR-RULE-PACKS](../../../records/0101_rule-packs.md) decision 9). † a preset `init` writes only when the repo has what it is for.

| Rule | By default | Severity | Preset |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`css-modules/class-naming`](../css-modules/class-naming.md) | off — opt-in preset | — | `css-modules/strict` |
| [`css-modules/composes-valid`](../css-modules/composes-valid.md) | on with `preview = true` | error | `css-modules/recommended`, `css-modules/strict` |
| [`css-modules/no-global`](../css-modules/no-global.md) | off — opt-in preset | — | `css-modules/strict` |
| [`css-modules/no-undefined-class`](../css-modules/no-undefined-class.md) | on with `preview = true` | error | `css-modules/recommended`, `css-modules/strict` |
| [`css-modules/no-unused-class`](../css-modules/no-unused-class.md) | on with `preview = true` | warn | `css-modules/recommended`, `css-modules/strict` |
